mission: SNKRDUNK diagnostic release (owner option A, 2026-10-28). The first live captures after #231 never saw the product page's size-chips response (condition_prices:not_seen after 15 s; work 196 retries, nothing recorded). Before changing the wait again, a capture whose prices did not load logs what the page actually requested (non-asset requests, responses, failures, the browser's fetch/XHR resource timings, page visibility and picker position) on its product_result line. Logging only: no outcome, request or write changes. Released to snkrdunk-collector only, by staging-automerge.

impacts.reason: NetworkTrace listeners on the product page (request, response, requestfailed; bounded to 80 entries, assets only counted) and one page.evaluate of page state, attached to condition_prices evidence only when prices did not load. No new request; no outcome change. The infrastructure effect is the mission-scoped release of snkrdunk-collector.
Trace content, bounds, no trace on a loaded capture, every listener removed.

routes: SNKRDUNK product pages, unchanged; no new request
impact.deployment_impact: snkrdunk-collector re-uploaded on the merge commit with automatic rollback. Behaviour unchanged; product_result lines for captures whose prices did not load gain a network trace.

recovery.procedure: The rollout captures the live snkrdunk-collector deployment before upload and restores it on failure; afterwards collector-redeploy to the fleet pin. Code: native revert PR with its own mission file.
recovery.trigger: Collector errors or log ingestion problems after release.

verification.observation_window: Delivery verify; the next SNKRDUNK turn's product_result for work 196 carries the network trace.
